method: Unchanged recurrence-budget-v2 training-only choice among three full GINE blocks, with abstention
hypothesis: Graph-level recurring member-gradient differences may identify where extra private capacity is useful under limited observed labels; complete-label controls can refute this hypothesis.
source_math: source/sharing_policy/replay_recurrence.py and recurrence_collector.block_statistics are byte-identical preserved originals
private_block: All trainable parameters in one GINEBlock: node LayerNorm, per-block BondEncoder tables, GINE epsilon, both MLP linears. AtomEncoder, boundary projectors/factors, and output LayerNorm stay shared.
budget: 3 times actual one-block count, at most one block; copied block retains four independent BondEncoders, and removes unused shared parameters
grouping: Union of exact canonical isomeric SMILES and identical stereo-free Bemis-Murcko scaffold; all empty scaffolds also stay together. Grouping reads official train mapping rows only, has no labels/metrics or similarity threshold.
folds: Seed700 allocates observed molecule/scaffold groups P/Q by greedy graph-count balance; seeds701/702/703 allocate Q groups A/B. Graphs sharing a group never cross a fold boundary. Large-group imbalance is reported.
loss: Each observed graph is weighted equally; finite targets are averaged within each graph. Hidden target values are replaced by NaN before graph use. Folds remain equal-fold means; no graph-count reweighting of C/N.
test_scope: Probe only reads training-only bundle. Exporter materializes existing all-target torch storage; csv.DictReader may internally materialize public heldout label columns and SMILES. Only train tensor targets and train-row SMILES are selected/hashed/grouped/exported; no heldout diagnostics or scores. No test-blind storage certification.
locking: Freeze bundle, group allocation, observed masks, sources, full GINE block counts and environment before any probe fit; finish all six seed/fraction locks before first predictive validation comparison.
placement_control: first/middle/last all have the same measured extra capacity; do not replace the selector with the validation-best placement
parameter_matching: Prospective amendment must construct size controls for actual selected capacity; abstention is TIED, not a hidden switch to middle. Existing middle-matched controls do not count as TIED-matched when selection abstains.
later_initialization: Restart every matched sharing layout from same canonical seed initial state; do not use P25 weights to give only selected arm a warm start.
independent_confirmation: MolHIV label fractions/seeds and reused official split are development. No independent-confirmation claim; later Peptides route remains separate and unaccessed.
probe_cost_accounting: Training, batched gradients, checkpoint saves, replay and mask/group preparation are extra adaptive-method overhead; record these before any efficiency claim.
